info.name: AML OCR API
info.description: Postman collection for the OCR Controller endpoints.

formdata.description: The image or PDF files to be processed by the OCR engine. Multiple files can be uploaded using the same key 'files'. Supported extensions: .pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .bmp, .webp

request.description: Upload document(s) for OCR data extraction. The endpoint takes a `multipart/form-data` payload containing an array of files. It returns a JSON object with extracted fields such as firstname, lastname, dob, document_number, etc.
